I build things that ship.

AI agents in production, native desktop apps, and the cloud plumbing underneath them.

I've been shipping software for 20+ years, from serverless platforms and data pipelines to a native screen recorder and AI agents that run inside real operations. These days I build with MCP servers, Claude Code plugins, computer-use and voice agents, Rust and Tauri.

Nullcolor

product

Native macOS and Windows app that records screen and webcam together, with a built-in editor, 4K/60 MP4 export and a searchable recording library. Free for individuals, $99 commercial licence.

  • native desktop
  • macOS
  • Windows
  • Kineto

nullcolor.app ↗

Kineto

open source

The composition engine inside Nullcolor, open-sourced. A cross-platform Rust binary that gives a screen recording a cinematic treatment (background, padding, rounded corners, shadow, eased auto-zoom) on static FFmpeg, libx264 and libx265.

  • Rust
  • FFmpeg
  • libx264
  • libx265

github.com/onevarez/kineto-engine ↗
